n, m, Mod = map(int, input().split())

MAX_LIMIT = 577

# Initialize combination table
C = [[0] * MAX_LIMIT for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)]
for i in range(MAX_LIMIT):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
for i in range(1, MAX_LIMIT):
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[j][i] = (C[j][i - 1] + C[j - 1][i - 1]) % Mod

def computeSum(start, end):
    return ((start + end) * (end - start + 1) // 2) % Mod

dp = [0] * MAX_LIMIT
dp2 = [0] * MAX_LIMIT
res = [[0] * MAX_LIMIT for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)]
res2 = [[0] * MAX_LIMIT for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)]

dp[0] = 1
dp2[0] = 0

for length in range(1, n + 1):
    for i in range(1, length + 1):
        sum_value = computeSum(1, i - 1) + computeSum(1, length - i)
        total_count = length + 1
        val1 = (dp[i - 1] * total_count) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        val2 = (sum_value * dp[i - 1]) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        val3 = (dp2[i - 1] * total_count) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        val4 = (dp2[length - i] * total_count) % Mod * dp[i - 1] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1]
        dp[length] = (dp[length] + val1) % Mod
        dp2[length] = (dp2[length] + val2 + val3 + val4) % Mod

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        res[i][j] = res[i - 1][j]
        res2[i][j] = res2[i - 1][j]
        for h in range(1, j):
            res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res2[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp2[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
        res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + dp[j]) % Mod
        res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + dp2[j]) % Mod

print(res2[n][m])
